# About the role
As the Senior Analyst, Total Rewards (Data Insights & Modeling), you will be a strategic partner reporting directly to the SVP, Total Rewards.
You will bridge the gap between complex data science and talent strategy, serving as a lead architect for our global compensation structures.
You will go beyond traditional reporting to build and maintain the predictive models that forecast salary market movement, simulate compensation cycles, and drive pay equity outcomes.
This position is pivotal in ensuring our compensation practices remain fair, equitable, and market-relevant, directly supporting our ability to attract and retain the world-class talent necessary to sustain The New York Times’s journalistic mission.
# Responsibilities
- Strategize design and maintenance of global compensation structures using advanced data science and predictive analytics.
- Develop sophisticated models for variable pay (AIP/LTI) and annual merit/bonus cycles under various business performance scenarios.
- Build predictive models to forecast salary market movement and internal budget requirements.
- Conduct statistically significant pay equity analyses to identify and remediate gaps across demographics.
- Build and maintain automated Total Rewards benchmarking tools and executive dashboards.
- Lead the advancement of data insight capabilities to support compensation analytics for the New York Times workforce.
- Manage participation in external compensation surveys, including job matching and data validation.
# Basic Qualifications
- 5–8+ years of experience in Compensation or Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), with at least 3 years focused on advanced modeling.
- Proficiency in statistical analysis (correlation and regression) and experience with HCM systems (e.g., Workday).
- Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, Power Query, Complex Nested Formulas) and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Visier).
# Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources or related field
- Experience with SQL, Python, or R.
- CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or GRP certification.

Title: Product Manager
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# Who We Are.
Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting.
Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in nine regions.
With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.
# Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!
As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for owning and driving product initiatives across Axi’s product ecosystem.
You will work closely with the Product Director, Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify customer and business problems, define product solutions, and drive initiatives from discovery through execution and measurement.
This role is suited to a product professional who can operate independently, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, communicate a strong point of view, and balance customer needs with business and technical considerations.
You will have the opportunity to work across different product areas and contribute to building products that support Axi’s global customers and business growth.
# Your EDGE Assignment/You Will
- Own and drive product initiatives from problem identification and discovery through execution, launch, and measurement.
- Understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear product opportunities.
- Define problems effectively by asking the right questions, analysing available information, and identifying the underlying customer or business need before moving to solutions.
- Develop product requirements, PRDs, user journeys, prioritisation frameworks, and success metrics.
- Work closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders to deliver product initiatives end-to-end.
- Manage product backlogs and prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business impact, effort, and strategic objectives.
- Use data, customer insights, research, and market understanding to inform product decisions.
- Communicate product decisions, trade-offs, priorities, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve challenges and maintain alignment throughout the product lifecycle.
- Take ownership of outcomes rather than simply coordinating requirements or delivery activities.
- Identify opportunities to improve existing products and experiences while exploring new product opportunities.
- Contribute to broader product strategy and help connect individual initiatives to larger business objectives.
- Work effectively in ambiguous and evolving problem spaces and demonstrate the ability to adapt across different product domains.
# Are you the one?
- Typically, 4–6 years of experience in Product Management, with flexibility based on demonstrated product ownership and competency.
- Proven experience owning and delivering products or significant product features end-to-end.
- Strong product thinking with the ability to identify and clearly define customer and business problems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured approaches.
- Clear and confident communication, with the ability to articulate ideas and recommendations with a strong point of view.
- Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
- Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
- Good understanding of product discovery, prioritisation, roadmap planning, execution, and product measurement.
- Ability to make informed decisions by balancing customer needs, business objectives, data, and technical considerations.
- Experience working across multiple product areas or domains is a plus and demonstrates adaptability to new problem spaces.
- Experience in fintech, trading, payments, or other financial technology environments is preferred but not mandatory.
- Experience in areas such as onboarding, customer experience, growth, platforms, partnerships, or other customer-facing products is a plus.
- Strong core Product Management experience is essential. Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on Business Analysis, requirements gathering, or consulting without direct product ownership are not aligned to this role.
# Axi's bag of delights
- Competitive and attractive compensation.
- Extensive learning opportunities, including professional certifications and continuous development.
- 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
- Public holidays as declared by the local government.
- Maternity leave as per applicable laws.
- Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
- Opportunity to work with global teams and modern, large-scale trading platforms.

Title: Product Manager Admissions and Finance Systems
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# About International House
Truly a unique and inspirational organization, International House at UC Berkeley is a non-profit residential and program community committed to fostering intercultural respect, mutual understanding and leadership skills, so that residents and alumni promote a more equitable and peaceful world.
I-House is home to graduate and undergraduate students, visiting scholars and interns from across the United States and around the world.
The building operates year-round as a residence, a dining hall, a conference and events venue and a program center, which means the systems that run it touch admissions, finance, housing operations, dining, facilities, security and human resources at the same time.
# Position Overview
The Product Manager, Admissions and Finance Systems owns the systems that move a resident from application through to payment.
You will support the Admissions and Financial Aid Department with the annual application build, billing and payment automation, and the reporting that tells the organization whether any of it is working.
This is a product role rather than a help desk role.
You will decide how a process should work, build or configure it, test it, document it, and then own the consequences when the cycle runs.
The application build in particular is a fixed calendar commitment: it has to be complete and tested before offers go out, and there is no manual fallback.
You will work most closely with Admissions and Financial Aid, Accounting, Housing Operations and the technical team, and with StarRez and our payment providers.
# Key Responsibilities
# StarRez and the application cycle
- Build, configure and test the annual application in StarRez for each cycle, to a deadline set by the offer calendar, and hand it to the Director of Admissions and Financial Aid for sign-off.
- Own day to day StarRez administration and troubleshooting, including terms, rates, room and rate assignment, booking statuses and the business rules behind them.
- Maintain the integrity of booking and contract records. Reporting problems are solved in the reporting, not by deleting records.
- Support move-in and move-out cycles, including the access, card and data steps that have to happen in the right order.
# Billing, payments and finance automation
- Own the accounting automations that apply late fees and charges, run payment schedules, and generate the resident statement of account.
- Own the payment integrations and the routing behind them, including Stripe and TouchNet, and the webhook and signing key configuration each provider requires.
- Make sure the resident-facing account summary in the portal reflects what the ledger actually says, including awards and scholarships that are split across terms.
- Work with Accounting on reconciliation, deferred revenue and the accounts receivable tie-out, and make the systems produce what the auditors ask for.
# Integrations across the resident lifecycle
- Own the data flow between StarRez and the operational platforms, including Atrium for meal plans and account balances, Verkada for access and resident photos, Adobe Sign for contracts, and WhenToWork for student worker scheduling and access.
- Build and maintain Power Automate flows that support admissions, finance and housing operations, and make sure each one is documented and monitored.
- Diagnose and resolve integration failures, and where a failure repeats, change the process rather than repeating the fix.
# Reporting and data
- Own the data models and reporting infrastructure in Power BI that serve admissions, occupancy, revenue and resident satisfaction.
- Own the survey and satisfaction data pipeline, including the Qualtrics extract and the load that feeds the weekly reporting.
- Make sure each report has a defined owner, a refresh that is monitored, and a definition that people agree on.
# Documentation and continuity
- Document systems, processes and business rules to a standard that lets a colleague run the cycle without you.
- Export code, workflow configurations, integration logic, database schemas and related artefacts to the shared repository.
- Keep an accurate record of which system owns which decision, and where each responsibility sits if you are unavailable.
Other duties as assigned.
# Required Qualifications
- Three or more years of experience owning a business system or product end to end, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Demonstrated experience configuring and administering a complex operational platform, ideally a student housing, CRM, ERP or billing system.
- Strong applied data skills. You can query a database, reason about a schema, and build reporting that other people trust.
- Experience building automation, for example with Power Automate, APIs or a comparable toolset.
- Understanding of billing concepts, including charges, payment schedules, statements, refunds and reconciliation.
- The discipline to hit a fixed calendar deadline on a build that other teams depend on.
- Clear written communication and genuinely good documentation habits.
# Preferred Qualifications
- Direct StarRez experience, in particular the annual application build.
- Experience with Stripe, TouchNet or comparable payment platforms and their webhook and reconciliation models.
- Experience with Power BI data modelling.
- Experience in higher education, student housing, or a non-profit finance environment.
- Familiarity with Atrium, Verkada, Adobe Sign, Blackbaud or Qualtrics.
# What Success Looks Like
- The application cycle is built, tested, and signed off ahead of the offer calendar, every cycle.
- Charges, late fees and statements are correct without anyone checking them by hand, and residents see the same numbers we do.
- Reporting is current, owned and trusted, and a stopped data load is noticed by monitoring rather than by a director asking why a dashboard is empty.
- The systems you own can be operated by someone else while you are on leave.
# Working Conditions
This position requires regular on-site attendance at International House, 2299 Piedmont Avenue, Berkeley.
Additional hours are expected around the application build, the offer cycle, and move-in.
# Compensation and Benefits
- FLSA Status: Exempt, full-time (40 hours per week)
- Pay range: $85,000 $90,000 annualized
- Pay is commensurate with experience and qualifications
- Benefits: International House offers a robust and competitive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement contributions, and paid leave. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.
- Retirement: Eligible employees may participate in our 403(b)-retirement plan. I-House offers a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 5% of eligible compensation and an additional employer non-elective contribution for eligible employees, in accordance with the terms of the plan.
- Time-off: Accrue up to 18 days of paid vacation annually, earn 14 paid holidays each year, and accrue paid sick time.
- Location: This role requires on-site presence and engagement with staff, leadership, and stakeholders in Berkeley, CA. No remote work options are available for this role.
